scope: Exploratory, outcome-informed PolypGen training comparison; evaluation sequences were previously inspected. No patient-independence or held-out confirmation claim.
method: Use 20 clips: ten fixed outcome-informed training-set return windows interleaved with the original pilot first ten author-sampled clips. Apply the pinned SAM2 sampler to each window; retain native memory and the regional, shuffled and generic residual heads.
evaluation: Full autonomous propagation and equal-sequence present-frame Dice; also record boundary F, false alarms and return episodes. The four-sequence comparison is exploratory and cannot establish a reliable improvement.
rationale: Tests training exposure to sampled-frame disappearance and return against the earlier 20-clip uniform pilot; schedule changes are confounded with individual clips, order and their gradients.
